about: Source files and what the isolated declaration emit says of their exported surface: `open` when some export needs inference, `annotate` the kind of annotation each problem asks for, in source order. The hfs cache (surfaceOf) and the explicit-export-surface rule of both lint canons are held to this one table.

cases.name: an arrow hook without a return type
an async function without a return type
a function with an untyped parameter
a const initialised by a call
cases.code: export const settings = makeSettings()

cases.name: an object literal with an inferred member
an object literal with a spread and a shorthand member
a local binding exported by name
cases.code:
const hidden = make()
export { hidden }

cases.name: a destructured export
cases.code: export const { first, second } = make()

cases.name: a static class property from a call
a default export function without a return type
a default export of a local const
cases.code:
const view = make()
export default view

cases.name: a default export object holding a call
cases.code: export default { a: make() }

cases.name: a component returning a variable
an async component
a component returning one JSX value
cases.code: export const Card = ({ title }: { title: string }) => <section>{title}</section>

cases.name: a component returning JSX, a conditional of JSX and null
re-exports
cases.code:
export { thing } from "./thing"
export * from "./all"
export type { Shape } from "./shape"

cases.name: explicit annotations
type-only exports
literal values
cases.code:
export const retries = 3
export const name = "x"
export const list = [1, 2] as const
export const tag = { kind: "a", size: 1 }

cases.name: an inferred helper that is not exported
cases.code:
const inner = () => make()
export const used: number = inner()
